name: ernestdefoe/studio
description: Studio — an image-first masonry theme for Flarum 2, for photo, art and maker communities. A gallery of each discussion's own pictures, creator cards, a spec sheet and critique replies, and a full-bleed dark gallery mode.

suggest.flarum/tags: Medium chips above the gallery and the medium on each card.
suggest.fof/upload: Uploaded pictures become covers with exact sizes and small thumbnails.
suggest.ianm/follow-users: A Follow button on the creator card.
suggest.flarum/likes: An Appreciate button on the creator card.
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: Widgets beside and above the gallery.
suggest.ernestdefoe/garage: The creator card links a member's builds.
suggest.ernestdefoe/projects: The creator card links a member's projects.
suggest.ernestdefoe/atrium: The creator card links a member's gallery.
suggest.ernestdefoe/wardrobe: Offer Studio beside other themes, chosen by each member.

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
